Presented file
Phase 21 is in positional-phase21.tar.gz, which holds 93 files: the 91 launcher_*.xml art vectors, README.md, and the new app/src/test/java/app/simple/positional/constants/LauncherArtTest.kt. Extract it at the repo root. There are no files to delete.

What changed in the art vectors

Rounding: coordinates are rounded to 0.1 viewport units. The rounding is applied to absolute positions, and relative values are recomputed from the rounded points, so errors don’t build up along long relative paths.
Shorter path syntax: the output uses the shortest number form (.5, - as separator) and leaves out repeated command letters. Zero-length line segments are dropped, except in paths that use s, because there dropping them would change the curve.
Default attributes removed: fillType="nonZero", alpha of 1, gradient type="linear" and tileMode="clamp" are gone. Paths with a transparent strokeColor also lose all their stroke attributes.
Clips: clips that cover the whole viewport are removed. Rectangle clips are also removed when the exact Bézier bounds of everything inside them (plus stroke width) already fit within the rectangle. Groups left with no attributes are unwrapped. This removes about 2,300 of the 5,500 clip paths. Each clip is a canvas clip on every draw, so this also cuts drawing work.
Size: about 36% smaller, from 16.2 MB to 10.4 MB of XML.
Visual check: I converted each original and new vector to SVG and rendered both at 2400 px wide. The average pixel difference is 0.04/255. The worst case was a few anti-aliased edge pixels, and side by side the two versions look the same.
Test and docs

LauncherArtTest:
every art has a colour pair, and the art count matches the drawables;
every pathData is fully parsed with the correct number of arguments for each command;
every non-arc number has at most one decimal.
README: phase 21 is marked done, and the test list is updated. Phase 22 is next: rasterise the launcher art once at display size, off the main thread, for the splash screen, arts pager and sun time art widget.
There’s no Android SDK here, so CI will run the first real build and lint.

Worth checking on the Nord

Open the app several times so you see a few different splash arts, day and night.
Scroll through the arts pager in Settings and look for missing shapes or shapes spilling past their edges.
Check that the sun time art widget still draws.
